newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Keells shares up 1.5 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: Keells shares up 1.5 pct on results.

text.p: Shares of blue chip conglomerate John Keells Holdings rose 1.52 percent or five rupees to 335 rupees on Tuesday on strong interim results, brokers said.
"The share price is reacting to the group's first-quarter results which are amazingly good," said a local broker.
The group said net profits for the three months ended June 30 had risen 170 percent to 130.42 million rupees.
The company consolidates accounts with 61 firms of which 14 are listed.
